value.aktivitet: Forvalte fornybar energi, ved å lagre fornybar energi i sanntid på havbunnen i mekaniske batteri. Dette gir økt bærekraft, da vi kan distribuere 100% fornybar energi gjennom hele døgnet direkte til eksisterende strømnett globalt. Tjenesten, og produktet kan også brukes til å lagre svinn ved overproduksjon, balansere strømnettet i kjernetid, samt levere store mengder energi på kort tid. Som f.eks overføre fornybar energi til fly, skip, industri der hvor eksisterende strømnett ikke klarer å levere energi raskt, og stabilt nok. Tjenesten, og produktet skal kunne ta imot, og lagre energien fra alle fornybare, og fossile kilder. Og leverer 100% fornybar energi, uten utslipp, uten svinn, og uten ytre påvirkninger av miljøet gjennom hele døgnet. Fremtiden er fornybar energi, og vi forvalter den for deg.

value.main_text_excerpt:
More value for less impact
Our technology harvest and store all surplus real time energy generation incl. idle power (renewable, nuclear and fossil) with 24/7 OnDemand distribution.
This enables full utilization of theoretical capacity factor on developed energy generation thru out the lifecycle of the investment. Improved utilization equals higher return on investment with the potential revenue in every kW generated from the source in real time.
OKER energy AS
M I S S I O N
Pure dynamics towards Net Zero
Pioneering the future sustainable global marketplace for electricity to the energy sector with our scalable and modular Energy Bank we buy, sell and offer storage-as-a-service.
OKER Energy - Offshore Kinetic Energy Reservoirs is a Scandinavian start-up company that develops SW PHES - Sea water pumped hydro electric storage for the global electrification and electro fuel production market.
Our technology harvest and store all surplus real time energy generation incl. idle power (renewable, nuclear and fossil) with 24/7 OnDemand distribution.
This enables full utilization of theoretical capacity factor on developed energy generation thru out the lifecycle of the investment. Improved utilization equals higher return on investment with the potential revenue in every kW generated from the source in real time.
- 
Scalable to perform industrial- to grid scale operations with pure renewable, reliable and affordable electric power worldwide.
- 
Modular for excellent performance to cover realtime base-, balance- and peak load demands around the clock.
- 
Flexible to operate as a battery, accumulator and capacitor as it performs multiple daily cycles without any loss of efficiency or capacity during operations.
Development target of 100year/100.000 cycles per reservoir with modular remote and topside maintenance.
Vision:
Zero energy emission - Zero energy waste - Zero environmental impact
Mission:
Pure dynamics towards Net Zero
Values:
More value for less impact
Oker Energy provide regions and industries with extra on-demand storage needed to achieve a sustainable reliable energy supply around the clock with low emission down to zero emission. All energy mixes can be stored and fully utilized with zero energy waste. Effect, voltage, and capacity are made to needs. With a service life lasting for decades without degradation and zero environmental impact.
The solution operates on the energy it is managing when charging. Deep sea hydro static pressure and atmospheric pressurized air when discharge. 100% renewable and ecologic process. It can perform both cycles simultaneous at full effect for efficiency and performance. Market leading energy return and low cost.
Our management and storage solutions can contribute in a massive scale to reach the goals for a sustainable and affordable future for industries that to today only can trust fossil fuel to operate the processes and production around the clock.
We can make electrification possible for sectors:
Mobility - Transportation - Aviation - Maritime - Shore-power - General grid support
Electro fuel production - Oil and Gas extraction - Mineral mining
Aquaculture - Agriculture - Crypto - Data storage and more.
If it can operate on electricity we support it and decarbonize it.
We belive that stored energy is 50 per cent of the future energy supply and technology if one wants to reach net zero.
From 60MWh to desired achievement.
Did you know that transfer loss is less than 3% per 1000km transfer?
With that said we can contribute to decarbonize a lot of sectors and give access to sustainable growth and development in decades to come.
Zero energy emission - Zero energy waste - Zero environmental impact Sustainability achieved
Vision
Zero Energy Emission - Zero Energy Waste - Zero Environmental Impact
Our goal is to deliver great opportunities to reach net zero at an affordable cost. With access to the right resources, we can become carbon neutral with renewable sources and gain control to fulfill our need for clean energy. Learn more about our work by getting in touch with our team today.
What´s Next
With our company’s mission always in mind, we strive to find new strategies for dealing with this challenge. Advocacy is something that we take very seriously, and our team is working each and every day to make a positive impact. Contact us to learn more about our commitment to this cause.
